subject.title: Review path for an AIPOU MCP receipt skill with explicit no-hidden-wallet-action rules

question: Should ClawHub allow or recommend an AIPOU-like wallet-capable MCP receipt skill, and if so what review evidence and metadata surface should gate listing?
rationale: This decides a user-trust and wallet-action boundary; the source tree can show existing audit primitives, but it cannot choose the policy for settlement-capable community packages or where OpenClaw should expose receipt metadata.

options.title: Decide policy first
options.body: Resolve wallet-capable MCP receipt eligibility and metadata placement through the broader vetted-plugin and content-policy RFCs before changing schemas, docs, or UI.

options.title: Pilot local-receipt-only listing
options.body: Allow an experimental AIPOU listing only for local receipt mode with explicit no-claim defaults, runtime proof, and no recommendation or vetted badge.

options.title: Decline wallet-capable listings
options.body: Treat AIPOU-like crypto, reward, or settlement skills as outside the public registry until maintainers approve a narrower exception policy.

recommendation.title: Decide policy first
recommendation.body: Resolve wallet-capable MCP receipt eligibility and metadata placement through the broader vetted-plugin and content-policy RFCs before changing schemas, docs, or UI.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick owns the current trust, audit, acceptable-use, and package-channel surfaces most directly affected by this decision.
